title: 19--Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore - Search-and-Rescue Personal Watercraft
description: Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore - Search-and-Rescue Personal Watercraft Units PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD SOLE SOURCE Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore - Search-and-Rescue Personal Watercraft Units The Department of the Interior (DOI), National Park Service (NPS), Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore, located in Empire, Michigan, intends to award a firm-fixed-price purchase order to RP Advanced Mobile Systems, LLC (RPAMS) for the purchase of two (2) search-and-rescue personal watercraft units. Description of Requirement The National Park Service requires two (2) personal watercraft units specifically configured and equipped to support emergency search-and-rescue operations at Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore. The required units shall utilize a factory-produced BRP/Sea-Doo personal watercraft platform and incorporate specialized rescue modifications and equipment necessary to support the National Lakeshore's search-and-rescue mission. The required configuration shall maintain the applicable factory-original manufacturer's warranty following the required modifications and allow the units to remain serviceable through the manufacturer's established dealer and qualified powersports service network. The Government requires a complete personal watercraft solution configured for its specific search-and-rescue mission and is not seeking commercially available, unmodified personal watercraft alone. Basis for Intended Sole-Source Award The National Park Service conducted market research to identify sources capable of providing the required search-and-rescue personal watercraft configuration. Based on the results of the Government's market research, RP Advanced Mobile Systems, LLC (RPAMS) is the only U.S.-based company identified by the manufacturer as maintaining a formal partnership with BRP/Sea-Doo that authorizes RPAMS to modify factory Sea-Doo vehicles while maintaining the applicable factory-original manufacturer's warranty. This manufacturer-authorized relationship is a material requirement of the National Park Service's acquisition. The Government requires a factory-produced Sea-Doo platform that can be specifically modified for search-and-rescue operations while maintaining the manufacturer's warranty and established service support. The RPAMS configuration provides the Government with a factory-based Sea-Doo platform modified for emergency rescue operations while retaining access to Sea-Doo dealers and qualified powersports service facilities for routine service and maintenance. The configuration incorporates specialized RPAMS components necessary to provide the capabilities required for the National Lakeshore's search-and-rescue mission. Based on the Government's market research and the requirements described above, the Contracting Officer has determined that only one source is reasonably available to satisfy the agency's requirement as specified. Accordingly, the Government intends to solicit from and award to RP Advanced Mobile Systems, LLC. Acquisition Procedures The anticipated acquisition is for commercial products and is expected to be valued at or below the Simplified Acquisition Threshold (SAT). The acquisition will be conducted using the policies applicable to commercial products under FAR Part 12, in conjunction with the applicable Simplified Acquisition Procedures in FAR Part 13. In accordance with FAR 12.102, the Government has documented its determination that only one source is available and the basis for that determination. The anticipated contract type is firm-fixed-price. Applicable NAICS Code The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is: 336612 - Boat Building. The applicable small business size standard is 1,000 employees. Notice to Interested Sources THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTATIONS. However, responsible sources that believe they are capable of satisfying the Government's requirement may submit a capability statement for consideration by the Contracting Officer. Capability statements must demonstrate the respondent's ability to provide two (2) search-and-rescue personal watercraft units meeting the Government's requirements, including: - A factory-produced BRP/Sea-Doo personal watercraft platform; - Specialized configuration and modification for emergency search-and-rescue operations; - Manufacturer-authorized modification of the factory platform; - Retention of the applicable factory-original manufacturer's warranty following the required modifications; and - Continued serviceability through the manufacturer's authorized dealer or qualified service network. Interested sources should provide sufficient technical information and supporting documentation to demonstrate their ability to satisfy the requirement as specified. In particular, respondents should identify their relationship with the personal watercraft manufacturer and provide documentation demonstrating that their proposed modifications are manufacturer-authorized and will maintain the applicable factory-original warranty. The Government will consider timely responses to determine whether another responsible source is reasonably available to satisfy the requirement. A response to this notice will not, by itself, be considered a quotation or offer and will not obligate the Government to issue a solicitation or make an award. Response Deadline Responses must be received no later than 5:00 PM Eastern Time on September 9, 2026. The Government will allow 10 calendar days for responses, with August 31, 2026, counted as Day 1. Responses received after the stated deadline may not be considered. Response Information Any comments, questions, or capability statements concerning this notice shall be submitted via email only to: Adam Kircher Contract Specialist Department of the Interior, National Park Service adam_kircher@ios.doi.gov Responses should reference "Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore - Search-and-Rescue Personal Watercraft Units" and include the respondent's complete company name, address, point of contact, telephone number, email address, applicable NAICS code, and supporting technical documentation. The Government intends to proceed with the contemplated sole-source acquisition unless information received from responsible sources demonstrates that another responsible source is capable of satisfying the requirement as specified.

description: This is a REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ONLY. This notice is issued solely for information and planning purposes - it does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ)/Invitation for Bid (IFB)/Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFQ, IFB or RFP in the future. This notice does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service. Further, the U.S. Government is not seeking quotes, bids or proposals at this time and will not accept unsolicited proposals in response to this sources sought notice. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice. Submittals will not be returned to the responder. Not responding to this notice does not preclude participation in any future RFQ or IFB or RFP, if any is issued. The Government is seeking capable upfitters to provide and install heavy-duty push bumpers and PIT wraps for federal law enforcement SUVs and sedans during fiscal year 2027. The vehicle type that PIT/Push bars will be installed on is unknown at the time of this sources sought. In response to this sources sought, please provide the following information by email to michelle_shoshone@ios.doi.gov 1. Company Name & Address: * Point of Contact (Name, Title, Email, Phone): * Unique Entity ID (UEI) & CAGE Code: * Primary Business Size / Socioeconomic Status (e.g., Large, SB, SDVOSB, WOSB) 2. Please provide brochures in .pdf format for the following types of PIT/push bars that your company can provide to support a future acquisition. If there are vehicle restrictions for the PIT/push bar type, please ensure that data is included. a) Standard Push Bumper b) Lower PIT Wraps (Single Rail Fender Bars) c) Full Wrap / Heavy-Duty Grille & Headlight Guards d) Light-Ready / LED-Integrated PIT Bars e) Winch-Ready / Heavy Duty (HD) 3. Since exact vehicle makes, models, and model years (e.g., Ford Police Interceptor Utility, Chevy Tahoe PPV, Dodge Durango) are currently undetermined, what is your standard lead time for manufacturing and delivering mounting hardware once vehicle specs are finalized? 4. Do you maintain an inventory of standard, multi-vehicle compatible push bumpers, or are all mounting brackets manufactured strictly built-to-order? 5. It is anticipated that installation will be required within 50 miles of each of the following 3 locations. If your company can not support installation within 50 miles of each of these locations; how can you support this acquisition? For example, would your company pick up the vehicles for installation and deliver upon completion? Describe how you can support this acquisition. a) 1901 Anacostia Drive SE Washington, DC 20020 b) 210 New York Ave Staten Island, NY 10305 c) 1217 Ralston Ave San Francisco, CA 94129 6. If installation occurs beyond the 50-mile radius, does your company provide flatbed/transport pick-up and redelivery services? If yes, is transport pricing structured on a flat-rate per vehicle or a mileage-based rate? 7. Does your company offer mobile upfitting/installation teams capable of performing installation on-site at Government facilities (e.g., an agency bay or secure parking lot) at the designated locations? 8. What is your facility's secure vehicle storage capacity (indoor/fenced lot with 24/7 security) at or near each of the three performance locations? 9. Are installation services available directly on your GSA schedule, or are they provided as open-market items? 10. What is your typical turnaround time (in business days) per vehicle for installing a push bumper / PIT wrap assembly once a vehicle is delivered to your shop? 11. What standard commercial warranty is provided on both the hardware (finish/corrosion) and the installation labor? 12. Are your PIT bars engineered and tested to ensure non-interference with OEM vehicle crash sensors, forward-facing radar, and Supplemental Restraint Systems (SRS airbags)? 13. Please state your company's business size and socioeconomic status under NAICS 336390 (Motor Vehicle Parts Manufacturing - 1,000 employees) and/or NAICS 811111 (General Automotive Repair - $9.0M). If you are a Large Business manufacturer, do you anticipate utilizing local certified Small Business upfitters or subcontractors to perform installation within the designated 50-mile geographic zones? 14. Optional Capability Question: Does your company have the capability (either directly or via a GSA Contractor Team Arrangement / Subcontracting partnership) to provide and install Mobile Data Terminal (MDT) mounting/docking hardware alongside push bumper/PIT bar installations as part of a single turnkey fleet upfit requirement?

description: The United States Section of the International Boundary and Water Commission (USIBWC) is issuing a Solicitation for the complete the Design-Build of Retamal Dam Buoy System. Upon conclusion of the project, the new waterway barrier line will prevent public access to dangerous hydraulics upstream/downstream of the dam, the warning system and signage will alert the public of the danger ahead providing a waterway barrier line to include anchors, alert system, and warning signs at the Retamal Dam. The Construction includes, but is not limited to, site preparation, inspection of all systems and structures, disposal of debris and construction waste, quality control testing. The working hours of the USIBWC facility are 7:00 am to 3:30 pm, Monday through Friday. The Contractor and any subcontractors shall only work on site during these proposed hours. Contractor and subcontractor shall have identifying vehicular when working in the area. US Fish and Wildlife own land adjacent to Retamal Dam. Contractor shall stay clear of US Fish and Wildlife property. A site visit date is listed in the Solicitation. A completed Form 358 is also required prior to attendance at the prebid site visit. title: Entreprisekontrakt vedrørende oprensning af forurening på strand og i havet nær kysten samt reetablering af strand og havbund m.v.
description: Udbuddet angår en hovedentreprisekontrakt omfattende oprensning af forureningen ved Himmark Strand på Als. Forureningen er en af de 10 generationsforureninger. Formålet med oprensningen er at sikre, at forureningen ikke længere udgør en risiko for vandmiljøet. Ved at fjerne forureningen er formålet også at sikre, at området kan anvendes rekreativt, herunder at ophæve badeforbuddet og advarslen mod fiskeri. Hovedentreprisen omfatter miljøoprensning af to kystnære indsatsområder på østkysten af Als ud for landsbyen Himmark. Indsatsområderne er beliggende dels på strandarealer/strandenge og dels på søterritoriet og udgør henholdsvis 10.000 m² og 35.000 m². Indsatsområderne inddæmmes midlertidigt, således at vandspejlet kan sænkes, og udgravning samt jordhåndtering kan foretages relativt tørt. Inddæmningen på søterritoriet udføres af stenkastninger med en vandafskærende spunsvæg, der i nogle områder er forankret til en ankerspuns. Oprensningen foretages ved opgravning, og forurenet jord køres til jordrensning ved godkendte jordmodtagere. Det forventes, at der skal bortkøres i omegnen af 125.000 tons forurenet jord. Derudover forventes det, at en del jord ud over dette kan genbruges til genopfyld inden for området. Oppumpet grundvand og havvand ledes til et rensningsanlæg, der etableres på stranden. Rensningsanlægget forventes at kunne rense op til 70 m³ i timen som peak-belastning. Som en del af afværgeforanstaltninger i forhold til naturpåvirkning forventes det, at der skal plantes ålegræs på 60.000 m² i nærheden af projektet. Ligeledes skal der etableres 6.000 m² stenrev i nærheden. For at kunne udføre arbejdet skal der etableres byggeplads, omlægges eksisterende veje samt etableres en midlertidig kørevej. Berørte arealer skal retableres.

description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss mehrerer Rahmenverträge über Schlosser- und Schweißleistungen in den Heizkraftwerken der BEW Berliner Energie und Wärme GmbH im Berliner Versorgungsgebiet. Die Leistungen umfassen die planmäßige sowie störungsbedingte Instandhaltung, Instandsetzung, Änderung, De- und Remontage von Anlagenteilen, Rohrleitungen und Armaturen in Energieerzeugungsanlagen. Hierzu gehören insbesondere Schlosser-, Montage- und Schweißarbeiten einschließlich aller hierfür erforderlichen Nebenleistungen. Gerüstbauleistungen sind nicht Bestandteil des Leistungsumfangs. Die Leistungen werden bedarfsorientiert über Einzelabrufe beauftragt und sind sowohl während des laufenden Kraftwerksbetriebs als auch im Rahmen von Revisions- und Stillstandsmaßnahmen zu erbringen. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt hierbei die eigenverantwortliche Durchführung der Arbeiten einschließlich Baustelleneinrichtung, Bereitstellung der erforderlichen Arbeitsmittel, Qualitätssicherung, Koordination der Arbeiten sowie der technischen Dokumentation. Die Arbeiten sind unter Einhaltung der einschlägigen gesetzlichen, technischen und sicherheitsrelevanten Regelwerke, insbesondere im Bereich Kraftwerks- und Rohrleitungsbau, auszuführen. Ziel der Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe des Leistungsvolumens auf mehrere Auftragnehmer im Rahmen mehrerer anteiliger Rahmenverträge, um die erforderlichen Kapazitäten, eine hohe Flexibilität bei Revisionen und Störungen sowie die kontinuierliche Verfügbarkeit der Leistungen an den Kraftwerksstandorten des Auftraggebers sicherzustellen.

description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung von Stapelstühlen / Besucherstühlen an die Stadt Essen. Es soll ein Rahmenvertrag über eine Basislaufzeit von einem Jahr mit der dreimaligen Verlängerungsoption um je ein weiteres Jahr abgeschlossen werden. Der Vertrag beginnt mit Zuschlagserteilung, voraussichtlich ab dem 23. Oktober 2026. Der Vertrag kann seitens beider Vertragsparteien bis zum 30. Juni eines jeden Jahres gekündigt werden. Bleibt eine Kündigung des Vertrags aus, verlängert sich der Vertrag stillschweigend um jeweils ein weiteres Jahr. Der Vertrag endet, sobald der Auftragswert über das Auftragsvolumen für die Maximallaufzeit von 4 Jahren vollständig ausgeschöpft ist, spätestens jedoch 4 Jahre nach Auftragserteilung (voraussichtlich 22. Oktober 2030). Eventuelle Auftragserweiterungen nach § 132 GWB bleiben von dieser Regelung ausgenommen. Der zu schließende Rahmenvertrag beinhaltet die Lieferung verschiedener Stühle inkl. Zubehör, deren nähere Beschreibung der Leistungsbeschreibung entnommen werden kann. Um ein einheitliches Erscheinungsbild der Stapelstühle zu den bereits im Einsatz befindlichen Stühlen der Stadt Essen zu gewährleisten, müssen die drei mindestens zu liefernden Schalenformen zu den Positionen 1 bis 3 den in der Leistungsbeschreibung abgebildeten Schalenformen ähneln. Gerne können darüber hinaus weitere Schalenformen angeboten werden.
